newsitem.title: SPAIN: Elf's Cepsa buy part of earlier deal-BCH.
newsitem.headline: Elf's Cepsa buy part of earlier deal-BCH.

text.p: French energy group Elf's purchase of 1.14 percent of Spain's Cepsa was part of a previous agreement between Elf and Central Hispano (BCH), a joint statement from Elf and BCH said on Thursday.

"There has been no alteration in the agreements signed by both partners, to which previously Union Fenosa and Endesa have adhered. The acquisition made a few weeks ago of 1.14 percent of Cepsa by Elf is part of the mentioned agreements, which foresaw the last stakes taken by Endesa and Elf itself," the statement said.
BCH announced last year a strategic energy agreement with utilities Endesa, Cepsa and Fenosa.
The statement denied there had been any change in the control over the Spanish energy firm, adding that the agreement made between BCH and Elf was still valid.

"We should highlight Elf's shareholder status and board membership of BCH, and its role as international industrial partner of the bank, ratifying the commitment and the Spanish character of the Elf group in Spain," the statement added.
